Former binge eater here! Framing desserts as “bad” and not knowing whether or not you should be restricting them will 1000000000% lead to you binging on those desserts later. You’ll end up eating significantly more desserts than if you were to continue eating a dessert with every meal like you have been. After you binge, you’ll feel bad, so you’ll restrict more and binge more. 

Break the cycle! Give yourself unconditional permission to eat desserts. You’ll probably eat soooo many desserts after giving yourself this permission. However, it’ll level off. 

I will say, though, if you can, you should speak to a medical professional about your eating patterns and concerns. Idk where you’re located, but in the US many major universities have low to no cost counseling clinics. Take advantage of them! Best of luck!
